**नृमुखसिंहाप्तु - **

Sphinx

नृ (nṛ): Man, human

मुख (mukha): Face

सिंह (siṁha): Lion, powerful one

अप्तु (āptu): Body

नृमुखसिंहाप्तु (nṛmukhasimhāptu) can be interpreted as a being with the face of a human and the body of a lion, aligning with the traditional depiction of the sphinx.
